title: iberis contracta subsp. rifana
intro: Iberis contracta subsp. rifana, commonly known as Rock Cress or Rif Mountain Candytuft, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is a flowering perennial plant native to the Rif Mountains of Morocco, and is valued for its medicinal properties. The plant has been used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which provide therapeutic relief and help to reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Iberis contracta subsp. rifana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
